name: lms-v2
description: LMS 2.0 — root dev orchestration (runs backend-py + frontend together)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend-py/requirements.txt
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend-py,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend-py && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
